name: SP500Heatmap
subtitle: World Markets Map & Portfolio
promotionalText: 40 world stock indices, crypto and ETFs on one live heatmap. Now with AI market briefs, a screener, portfolio tracker, 60 model portfolios and 41 languages. Free, no ads.
description:
See the whole market in one picture. SP500 Heatmap turns 40 stock indices, the top 50 cryptocurrencies and the top 50 ETFs into interactive colour maps. Tap a sector, then an industry, then a company.

WORLD MARKETS MAP
• 40 indices: S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow, IBEX 35, Euro Stoxx 50, DAX, CAC 40, FTSE 100, Nikkei, Hang Seng, CSI 300, Nifty and more
• Crypto top 50 and top 50 ETFs
• Sector, industry and company maps for every index
• Periods: today, 1D, 3D, 7D, 30D, 180D, 1Y, 3Y, 5Y, 10Y
• Colour by % change, P/E, P/S, P/B, dividend yield, beta, revenue growth, 52-week range or relative volume
• Size by market cap, equal weight, volume or turnover
• Share any map as an image

COMPANY PAGE
• Pro chart: line or candles, volume, SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, compare with an index, crosshair
• Key data, annual and quarterly financials, analyst targets
• What famous investors hold (13F filings)
• Latest news

AI INSIGHTS
• "Why is it moving?" explanations
• Daily market brief
• AI chat about the market. On supported devices it runs on-device with Apple Intelligence; other devices get quick answers

SCREENER AND CALENDAR
• Screener across 3,400+ stocks with ready presets
• Earnings and dividend calendar, add events to Calendar

YOUR PORTFOLIO
• Track holdings with profit and loss in € or $, dividends, allocation and comparison with an index
• Import and export CSV, sync through iCloud
• Multiple watchlists with iCloud sync
• 60 model portfolios since 1926: Buffett, Dalio All Weather, Bogleheads and more, with a calculator in $ or € that includes inflation

ALWAYS WITH YOU
• Widgets for the Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy, plus Control Center
• Live Activity during the US session
• Push alerts: price, index move, daily summary, earnings and dividend reminders
• Colour-blind palette
• iPad split view
• 41 languages

Free. No ads. No account.

Market data is provided by third parties and may be delayed. SP500 Heatmap is for information only and is not investment advice.
